name: MemoryUsageWatchdog
src_typeComment: On-device memory monitor — periodically samples total allocated memory and fires OnThresholdExceeded (optionally running an automatic cleanup) when it crosses a limit, without needing the Editor Profiler attached. Aimed at exactly the failure mode a 24/7 kiosk with lots of image/video assets tends to hit: memory that creeps up over a long session because nothing ever explicitly unloads.

src_serialized.name: thresholdMB
src_serialized.tooltip: Total allocated memory (MB) that triggers OnThresholdExceeded and, if enabled, an automatic cleanup.

src_serialized.name: autoCleanupOnThreshold
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, automatically runs Cleanup() when the threshold is exceeded.

src_members.name: Tick
src_members.comment: Public so a self-test can drive the check interval with exact time increments without needing Play mode.

src_members.name: CheckNow
src_members.comment: Runs a check immediately, bypassing the interval timer — e.g. right before loading a large batch of assets.

src_members.name: Cleanup
src_members.comment: Frees unreferenced assets and forces a GC pass — the standard, blunt "reclaim what we can" response. Genuinely expensive (can cause a multi-frame hitch), so it's deliberately NOT called every check — only when the threshold is actually crossed, or when called manually.
